bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 60
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:startless-batch-db17)" || exit 61
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 62
attempted="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM startless_public_post_migrations;")" || exit 63
test "$attempted" = 90 || exit 64
before="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT chat_id||':'||message_id||':'||owner_user_id FROM profile_publications WHERE status='published' AND message_id>0 ORDER BY chat_id,message_id;")"
set +e
result="$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/refreshStartlessExistingPosts.mjs --apply 2>&1)"
rc=$?
set -e
printf '%s\n' "$result" | tail -n 8
echo LAST_BATCH_EXIT="$rc"
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT state||'='||count(*) FROM startless_public_post_migrations GROUP BY state ORDER BY state;"
test "$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM startless_public_post_migrations;")" = 95 || exit 65
after="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT chat_id||':'||message_id||':'||owner_user_id FROM profile_publications WHERE status='published' AND message_id>0 ORDER BY chat_id,message_id;")"
test "$before" = "$after" || exit 66
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 67
echo STARTLESS_ALL_95_TARGETS_ATTEMPTED_ONCE=PASS
echo OLD_POST_IDS_UNCHANGED=PASS
echo UNKNOWN_ENTRIES_NEVER_RETRIED=PASS
test "$rc" = 0 || exit 68
echo STARTLESS_FINAL_BATCH_ALL_APPLIED=PASS
